title: Lentils spinach | Dal Palak Restaurant Style | Healthy recipe
description: दाल पालक | Dal Palak Restaurant Style  How to make Restaurant Style Dal Palak? Easy to cook & Healthy Recipe by Chetna Patel.  Palak Dal or Dal Palak is a simple lentil curry with spinach. This Dal recipe is quick and easy to make and tastes best when had with steam rice. Do try it at home.  #YummyFood #DalPalak #HealthyRecipe  :film projector: Production by umyproduction.com

asr.full_text: Chitna's Kachori recipe Bitter Gourd Dalpalak Red Chilli Coriander Chilli powder Turmeric powder Boiled Rice Hello friends welcome to Food Couture I am Chitna Patel and I have came up with an recipe for you Restaurant Style Dal Palak This is made very easily and with very less ingredients So let us begin Ingredients Turmeric Powder Black Pepper Mustard seeds So, let's get started To make restaurant style dish, we First of all soak lentils Here, I am taking 1 4th cup lentils and will soak in water for one hour Here, I am taking normal water and we have to soak the lentils and soak it for one hour Here i am taking a normal cup of water And soak it for one hour See, our dal is soaking very well It will take an hour to soak Now let's boil it We will be using three types of dal for making dal palaka One i have used is chickpeas and it comes in a 1 fourth cup Masoor dal is use for one fourth cup 3 fourth cup is for two eggs Here we are going to use 3 dal, i.e 100 grams of chickpea , 50 grams of lentils and 350 grams of tapioca Now let's boil all these dal in cooker Here i am having pressure cooker to boil lentils now add soaked chickpea Take 1 cup Masoor dal, 3 cups Tur dal, 3 cups of water add a little bit turmeric powder add about 1.5 tsp of salt add 1 tsp of butter mix this mixture properly Pressure cook for 3 whistles Leave the stem Take 100 gram spinach Cut the stem long Boil spinach with boiled water Boil waterak in hot water Boil palak after the water is properly hot Add spinach Boil on medium flame Strain the mixture immediately pour it in cold water Take ice water here To prevent spinach from turning to black And remain green See dal is boiled add 1 cup of gram flour i am checking it the dal is ready i am taking 1 tbsp of ghee you can use oil instead of ghee i am taking 1 tsp Cumin Garlic Chopped Green chilli Onion Onions 2 and a half cup Heat the pan, on high flame Saute the onions till they get light golden in colour Keep the flame on high and keep stirring continuously So that it does not burn You can see now add the prepared red masalas Add dry fenugreek leaves Add Garam Masala Boil it for 2-3 seconds Add 1 cup finely chopped tomato Add 1 cup of salt here i have taken half cup tomato now add the salt continue stirring till tomatoes are cooked Add urad dal Add red chillies Add coriander seeds Add fried chicken Add chopped onions Add chopped tomatoes Cook all the ingredients with spices Add some water Add the boiled spinach Now add water in a pan Add 2 cups of water Now cook the dal is set Boiled Spinach Now we will add some oil to the pan Daal is ready, now for tempering For that I am using... 2 tsp Ghee You can use oil instead of the ghee 1 tsp Cumin Some garlic 1 tsp cumin seeds big chopped garlic 2 red chillies 1 pinch asafoetida Now put 2 tbsp, 1 or 1 1.5 tsp, hing Turn off the stove now add red chilies You will have to add it after turn off the gas Dal is very tasty Thank you for watching the video Hope you liked it Subscribe for more videos This dal is very tasty You can serve this with bread or paratha Or rice So do try this recipe I will wait for your feedback Until then happy cooking
